title: Gate count versus microphone and bin counts
caption: Existing 20–40 kHz estimate: lines and shading are the original fitted model and engineering allowance. The black marker is the measured original 16-mic/eight-bin circuit, including UART.
alt: Estimated gate count rises with selected-bin and microphone counts, with a 300k gate budget and one measured baseline point.

title: Measured savings from Fourier precision
caption: Holding 16 mics, eight bins, 512 samples and 441 directions fixed, total synthesis estimates fall from 206.7k to 197.5k, 177.7k and 157.2k NAND2 equivalents. All storage and UART are included.

title: Quality versus digital signal level
caption: Accumulator rounding and power-output rounding are different tradeoffs. Weak-output failures must be counted alongside relative errors; the wide reference itself produces nine zero maps at the weakest level.
alt: Two plots show accumulator pixel error and counts of all-zero maps as input signals become weaker.

title: Inspect the maps and their differences
caption: Worst relative-error case for the 34-bit accumulator: independent-noise seed 7, −46 dBFS peak input. Top maps share the reference intensity scale; bottom maps show signed numerical differences. This is one selected example, not an average.
alt: Reference, 34-bit and 26-bit acoustic maps with true-source circles above signed-error maps, all using shared scales.

title: Bins × microphones × accumulator precision
caption: New fitted curves and measured points at 42/Q32, 34/Q24 and 26/Q16 storage. Same fixed architecture; the original curves above remain unchanged.

title: Area versus stored Fourier width
caption: Fits at four and eight bins. Fractional precision and integer headroom are specified explicitly; other stage widths stay fixed.

title: Area versus window length
caption: Selected-bin DFT implementation: changing N affects accumulator guard bits and constants, not a full M×N PCM frame buffer.

title: Area versus angular grid spacing
caption: FOV is fixed at 60° per axis. The hardware reuses the datapath across directions and streams its single-window map.

title: Averaging and overlap storage budget
caption: Unimplemented planning calculation: only additional flip-flops for the named arrays are counted. Access logic and scheduling are excluded; these are not fitted total-area curves.

title: Sampling and decimation comparison
caption: Three complete synthesis points; the first and third match physical observation duration and bin spacing. Antialias performance is not qualified.

title: Near-budget candidates: sources and signals
caption: Seed-7 maps with identical source waveforms. Each map has its own normalization; read the absolute peak-power change beside every map.

title: Near-budget candidates: stress cases
caption: Noise, microphone mismatch and controls. Bright peaks in noise-only or out-of-view scenes are not detections.

title: Power retained by each candidate
caption: Median ratios across three seeds relative to the broad-spectrum, longer-observation software reference. Not calibrated acoustic sensitivity.

title: Controlled area/quality comparisons
caption: One setting/group varies relative to the 30-mic/eight-bin baseline. Hatched area bars include unimplemented analytical estimates.
